usage: cox chair [-h] {run,service} ...

The chair loop that runs the landing and launch ticks itself.

positional arguments:
  {run,service}
    run          beat, gather, plan, perform and report every tick until interrupted
    service      write or show the systemd user unit that keeps `cox chair run` alive

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit

examples:
  cox chair run --once --dry-run
  cox chair run --interval 30
  cox chair service --install
